title: Homeowner Service Contracts — Payment on Acceptance of a Company-Elected Offer
content:
**Request and offer used.** On a Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contract, the company-elected acceptance payment is worked out on the service request of the replacement authorization most recently issued on the contract, from the most recent company-elected offer on that request.

**Starting amount.** It starts from the accepted offer amount. The accepted offer amount is paid as the offer states it.

**Remaining benefits, as if reversed.** The remaining item benefit and the remaining aggregate benefit are counted as if the standing authorization had already been reversed: the tier's cap for the covered item less the payments on that item counted toward the remaining benefits with the authorization's amount taken back out, floored at zero, and the tier's aggregate term limit less every payment on the contract counted toward them with the authorization's amount taken back out, floored at zero. The cap and the limit are the figures the Homeowner Service Contracts schedule of benefits sets for the tier held.

**Payments counted.** A payment counts toward the remaining benefits when its event date falls within the twelve months before today, that is after the same calendar day twelve months earlier, whatever term its request fell in; repair, replacement, cash-in-lieu and out-of-network payments count toward the item, supplemental allowances count toward the aggregate only, and a reversal takes its authorization's amount back out of both counts.

**Payment.** The company-elected acceptance payment is the lowest of the amount so started, the remaining item benefit and the remaining aggregate benefit, never below zero, rounded to the cent once at the end.

**Scope.** For the acceptance of a company-elected offer made because no network contractor can install the replacement, and only for such an acceptance, the payment is the company-elected acceptance payment worked out here: it starts from the accepted offer amount and carries the offer's settlement basis "company elected"; every other accepted offer remains under the general cash-in-lieu payment rule. For a company-elected acceptance payment worked out under this rule, and only for such a payment, the item cap and the aggregate term limit are measured against the payments dated within the twelve months before today; every other payment remains measured by the term rule of the benefit caps. For a company-elected acceptance payment worked out under this rule, and only for such a payment, the item cap is still shared by every repair, replacement, cash-in-lieu settlement and out-of-network reimbursement for that item, counted over the payments dated within the twelve months before today rather than over the term; every other payment remains measured by the term rule of the benefit caps. For a company-elected acceptance payment worked out under this rule, and only for such a payment, every payment on the contract, supplemental allowances included, still counts toward the aggregate term limit, counted over the payments dated within the twelve months before today rather than over the term; every other payment remains measured by the term rule of the benefit caps. For a company-elected acceptance payment worked out under this rule, and only for such a payment, the remaining item benefit is still the item cap less the payments counted toward that item and the remaining aggregate benefit is still the aggregate term limit less the payments counted toward it, each floored at zero, with both counted over the payments dated within the twelve months before today; every other payment remains measured by the term rule of the benefit caps.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Bridgewell HomeCare Gold (cooling system cap 3500.00, aggregate term limit 20000.00). The most recent company-elected offer on the request is 1,240.00; the standing replacement authorization on it is recorded at 1,400.00. Payments counted in the twelve months before today: on the cooling system, the 1,400.00 authorization and 2,500.00 of earlier cooling work; on the contract, 18,000.00 in all.

| Step | Working | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| Starting amount | accepted offer amount | 1,240.00 |
| Remaining item benefit | 3,500.00 less (3,900.00 less 1,400.00) | 1,000.00 |
| Remaining aggregate benefit | 20,000.00 less (18,000.00 less 1,400.00) | 3,400.00 |
| Acceptance payment | lowest of 1,240.00, 1,000.00 and 3,400.00 | 1,000.00 |
